events.text: Jules: I’m going to mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and see who can help out.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Ira: That sounds great — I can ask around when I’m out running errands too.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a huge help. I’ll keep you posted if I hear back from anyone.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and repeat the plan to anyone who asks.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — could you tell me what’s confirmed for the repair drive so I can check we’re not missing anything? I’m trying to keep the logistics straight.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Jules: Hi Eli — I’m still just going by what I heard, but it sounds like the repair drive is still on for Saturday. If you know for sure, I could use an extra volunteer or a basic tool kit.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Pia: Thanks — Saturday sounds right, but I still need the confirmed volunteer and tool list so I can keep us from coming up short.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Noah: Yeah, it’s still on as far as I know—I just want to be sure before I start mentioning it around.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Jules: Thanks for checking, Noah—I'll mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and let you know if I hear anything back.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — appreciate it. Just let me know if anything changes, and I’ll keep an ear out too.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Jules: I’m still hearing that the repair drive is on for Saturday, and I’m checking on the final details. If you’ve got a confirmed update, I can pass it along and help round up a volunteer or two.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Dane: I’m late, but I can help too—what still needs fixing, and do you need any supplies picked up?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane — that’s really helpful. I’m still waiting on the final list, but a basic tool kit and any supplies for small fixes would be great.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can keep an ear out and bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what still needs doing.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’ll check what’s still needed and let you know which tools would be most useful.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll send along the needed list as soon as I have it, and I’ll keep you on the invite list too.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate you keeping an ear out. If you hear a confirmed update on Saturday’s repair drive, pass it along and I’ll help round up a volunteer or two.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll pass along any confirmed Saturday update I hear while I’m out.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Jules: It’s still looking like the repair drive is on for Saturday, and I’m checking the final details. If you’ve got a confirmed update, I can pass it along and help round up a volunteer or two.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we’ve got a decent turnout already, right? If anyone else asks, send them my way and I’ll keep the list updated.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Jules: Yes, turnout looks decent so far, and I’ll send anyone else your way. I’m still checking the final details and will pass along any confirmed updates.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Quinn: I’m still sorting out the repair-drive details, but I’ve got you on the invite list too. If you hear the first stop or what folks need, send it my way and I’ll spread the word.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and see who can help out. If I hear the first stop or what’s still needed, I’ll pass it along.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Jules—that’d be a huge help. I’ll keep an eye out too, and if I hear the first stop or any specific supplies, I’ll send it your way right away.
events.speaker: Quinn
